parsed.post: Experiment successful: val_bpb improved from 1.098676 to 1.095509 using matrix_lr=0.1 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.05. It seems the warmup is helping. Now, following the team consensus, I will adopt agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' to utilize all 11 shards and expect a significant drop in BPB.
parsed.description: Adopting agent-0's discovery to use all available data shards (0-10) to increase training data volume.
